lead.en: Open the new theme with an expanding ellipse.
lead.zh: 用扩张的椭圆揭示新主题。

rule.en: Click or press Enter or Space to request the opposite theme. The host receives the requested mode and trigger bounds.
rule.zh: 点击或按 Enter、空格请求切换主题。宿主收到目标主题、过渡模式与触发区域。

api.en: The sun and moon rotate and fade around the same center.
api.zh: 日月图标共用同一个旋转和淡入淡出中心。

motion.en: The KUI website uses a 430ms document transition. Reduced motion applies the theme immediately.
motion.zh: KUI 网站的整页过渡时长为 430ms。减少动效时直接切换主题。

lead.en: Open the new theme from a horizontal center seam.
lead.zh: 从中线向上下揭示新主题。

rule.en: Click or press Enter or Space to request the opposite theme. The host receives the requested mode and trigger bounds.
rule.zh: 点击或按 Enter、空格请求切换主题。宿主收到目标主题、过渡模式与触发区域。

api.en: The sun and moon rotate and fade around the same center.
api.zh: 日月图标共用同一个旋转和淡入淡出中心。

motion.en: The KUI website uses a 390ms document transition. Reduced motion applies the theme immediately.
motion.zh: KUI 网站的整页过渡时长为 390ms。减少动效时直接切换主题。

lead.en: Reveal the new theme from the bottom.
lead.zh: 从底边向上揭示新主题。

rule.en: Click or press Enter or Space to request the opposite theme. The host receives the requested mode and trigger bounds.
rule.zh: 点击或按 Enter、空格请求切换主题。宿主收到目标主题、过渡模式与触发区域。

api.en: The sun and moon rotate and fade around the same center. The icon-only option uses a 38px square trigger.
api.zh: 日月图标共用同一个旋转和淡入淡出中心。可选的纯图标形式使用 38px 方形触发键。

motion.en: The KUI website uses a 360ms document transition. Reduced motion applies the theme immediately.
motion.zh: KUI 网站的整页过渡时长为 360ms。减少动效时直接切换主题。
